Ecommerce

A Step-by-Step Guide to E-commerce Setup

  • Fixwebsite Issues
  • June 22, 2021
  • 4:01 pm
  • No Comments

Setting up an e-commerce website is just the first step. You’ll also need to consider things like customer service, inventory management, and marketing (including SEO, social media marketing, and email marketing) to make your online business a success.

Powerful Logo

A logo serves as the face of your company, often providing the first impression to potential customers. It’s an integral part of your brand identity, influencing your overall aesthetic, including your color schemes, typography, and overall design elements. This is why professional logo design should be one of your initial steps in your e-commerce planning process. Consider seeking professional help from renowned services like Logo In Hours LLC.

Choosing Your Domain

The first step in establishing your online presence is choosing a domain name. This name represents your business, so make it catchy, memorable, and easy to spell. It should resonate with your brand and what you offer. Registrar platforms like GoDaddy, Namecheap, HostGator, and Google Domains offer a plethora of choices.

Selecting Your Hosting Service

Hosting is essentially where your website lives on the internet. Choosing a reliable and quick hosting service is crucial for maintaining a smooth-running online store. BlueHost, SiteGround, and HostGator are some of the reputable providers. Many of them offer free SSL certificates, essential for securing your customers’ data and building trust.

Identifying Your Products

An e-commerce store is nothing without its products. Choose items you can source reliably and sell at a profit. Understand your target market’s needs and preferences to provide products that appeal to them.

Organizing Products into Categories

To enhance user experience, categorize your products appropriately. This systematic organization will enable customers to find their desired products easily, leading to higher conversion rates. Labels, Pictures of products etc should be ready.

Listing Your Products

Once categorized, list your products under the relevant categories. Each product should have a unique description, highlighting its features, uses, and benefits.

Detailing Your Products

For each product, ensure that you provide high-quality images from different angles, an informative description, the price, and information about its availability. These details influence a customer’s purchase decision. Creating an organized and engaging product listing is crucial to your e-commerce store’s success. Let’s imagine you have four distinct categories for your products: A, B, C, and D. Under Category A, you have five unique products denoted as A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5. To create a rich and compelling shopping experience, let’s focus on product A1. To truly showcase A1, make sure you provide 2 to 3 high-quality images for each product. This helps potential customers to have a complete understanding of what they are buying. They can explore the product from multiple angles, taking note of details that can influence their purchasing decision.

Accompany these images with a detailed product description. This should be engaging, yet informative, highlighting the unique features, benefits, and potential uses of product A1. A great description not only helps the customer understand the product better, but it can also boost SEO and improve the visibility of your products on search engines.

Setting Up Your Payment Options

A seamless checkout process can drastically reduce cart abandonment rates. Decide on your payment processing methods. PayPal and Authorize.net are good starting points, but other options like Stripe and Square are also worth considering. Don’t forget to think about tax computation and shipping fees.

Ongoing Website Maintenance

Post-launch, collaborate with your developer for regular website maintenance. Regular updates, troubleshooting, and incorporating customer feedback are all integral to keeping your website functional and user-friendly.

Website Speed and Updates

Speed is a vital factor in user experience. Slow websites can lead to high bounce rates and lost sales. Regular updates, including security patches, are necessary for smooth operation and to keep your site safe from potential threats.

Optimizing Your Website (SEO)

Once your website is up and running, focus on Search Engine Optimization (SEO). SEO strategies, including keyword optimization, creating high-quality content, and building backlinks, help your website rank higher in search results, attracting more organic traffic.

Website Design

Your website’s design should be aesthetically pleasing and easy to navigate. WordPress, known for its flexibility and the availability of various e-commerce plugins like WooCommerce, is a popular choice for e-commerce websites. Share samples of websites whose designs you admire with your developer for inspiration.

Charges for E-Commerce Website

The standard cost for a basic e-commerce website design lies within the range of $1000 to $1500. Payment can be in installment, but we make your website ready and live in 10 days. Then you can review the design and give feedback if any update required. This package includes 3 months of complimentary support, allowing for updates and the addition of new products. Typically, we assist in the setup of 20 products across all categories to get your online store up and running. As part of our service, we provide an instructional video that clearly outlines how you can add new products to your site independently.

Should you require ongoing maintenance support throughout the year, we offer this at a nominal charge of $300 per month. After operating your website for six months, you might consider delving into SEO to boost your site’s visibility. For this, an SEO-optimized e-commerce website is essential. We offer this at a price range of $2000 to $3000. Monthly SEO charge is separate. Our expertise lies predominantly in WordPress, and we utilize premium custom themes for website design. This ensures your e-commerce site is mobile-responsive, attractive, and user-friendly, providing an optimal browsing experience for all users, regardless of the device they use.

RECOMMENDATIONS

We consistently encourage our clients to conduct some preliminary research to streamline the design process. A good starting point is browsing Google to discover two or three e-commerce websites that you admire. This step allows you to envision the design aesthetic you’d be thrilled to see reflected in your own online store.

Having a clear idea of what you like in advance enables us to better understand your design preferences. It helps us deliver a design that aligns with your expectations and satisfaction. Whether it’s high-profile e-commerce websites like Macy’s or Target, or a niche site dealing in the same product line as yours, any reference point is valuable. By sharing these preferences with us, you actively contribute to crafting a website that truly embodies your vision.

Setting up an e-commerce website is a journey that requires planning, implementation, and continuous improvement. While the initial stages might seem overwhelming, taking one step at a time can make the process smoother and more manageable. Happy selling! Need consultation, please call us at 832 266 7209.
